detail.longDescription: Of 59 public AI agent incidents in Manifold's new ledger, 16 were noticed only after the damage showed up. A security control caught 11. Another 18 turned up in later review. Most agent failures are found by someone reading the aftermath, so long runs deserve a second pair of eyes while they are live. https://www. manifold.security/incidents shell --read-only claude gives a teammate a watch-only browser view of the run: https:// shell.online # AIAgents # Cybersecurity # DevOps
